description: This file defines the class HttpPublishTarget, which represents an HTTP target endpoint with a specific method and path, used for publishing messages via HTTP. It includes methods for creating instances from a target address string, and overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: HttpPublishTarget
classes.description: An immutable class representing an HTTP target with method and path, used for publishing messages.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an HttpPublishTarget from a string in format '<HTTP_METHOD>:/<HTTP_PATH>'. Defaults to POST method if the method is not recognized.

methods.name: splitMethodAndPath
methods.description: Splits the target address into HTTP method and path parts using ':' as separator.
